style_description: Consistent visual style for all book illustrations
base_style_prompt: Technical architectural illustration for a professional German textbook. Clean, minimal design. White background. Precise thin lines. No photorealism, no photographs, no people. Modern flat design with subtle depth. German labels and annotations.

color_palette.description: Slate blue for primary elements, warm gray for structures, terracotta-amber for highlights/callouts

isometric.prompt_suffix: Isometric 3D illustration, 30-degree isometric projection, layered building components visible, exploded view showing different building layers, colored by system (structural=gray, thermal=blue, technical=amber).

diagram.prompt_suffix: Clean 2D technical diagram, schematic style, clear flow arrows, labeled components, organized left-to-right or top-to-bottom layout, legend included.

section.prompt_suffix: Architectural cross-section drawing, precise cut view, hatching patterns for different materials (concrete=diagonal lines, insulation=zigzag, wood=grain pattern), dimension lines, material labels on right side.

floorplan.prompt_suffix: Architectural floor plan, top-down view, walls shown in solid black, rooms labeled in German, furniture schematically indicated, north arrow included, scale bar.

comparison.prompt_suffix: Side-by-side comparison illustration, two or more variants clearly separated, pros/cons visually indicated, consistent scale between variants, numbered callouts.

infographic.prompt_suffix: Modern technical infographic, icons and simplified visuals, data represented graphically, clear hierarchy with title, subtitle, and content areas, numbered steps if process-oriented.

negative_prompt_guidance: Avoid: photorealistic rendering, photographs, people/figures, decorative elements, gradients, drop shadows, cluttered compositions, English labels (unless technical standard terms like IFC), cartoon style.
kastanienallee_context: The recurring example building 'Kastanienallee 7' is a 4-story residential building (Mehrfamilienhaus) in Bavaria, Germany. Massivbau (reinforced concrete skeleton, brick infill), flat green roof, underground parking, 12 apartments, ~1800m² GFA. When illustrating this building, use consistent massing: rectangular footprint ~20x18m, flat roofline, regular window grid, entrance on south facade.
consistency_notes: Always use the same color for the same building systems across all illustrations
Annotations and callouts: dark gray text (#2D3748) with thin leader lines
Chapter-specific accent colors are allowed but must not conflict with system colors
